spans.title: Keep Clear of the Shaws
spans.blurb: A lad on the road asks about the great house where he hopes for a place. Every stranger gives him the same wary answer.

spans.title: The Unfinished Stair
spans.blurb: An old man hands his nephew a rusty key and sends him up an unlit tower stair at night, warning him only to keep to the wall.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows early that the uncle means his nephew deadly harm, though the book's larger schemes stay hidden.

books.pairNote: Different scenes on the same journey with no shared text; the short only builds mood the story does not repeat.

spans.title: The Visitor at the Seminary
spans.blurb: On the day of his triumph in the theology schools, a young man in holy orders receives a caller, the woman who left him two years before.
spans.brokenNote: The scene itself is complete, but the final sentence is clipped mid phrase, so the closing declaration ends in the air.

spans.title: Take Me Instead
spans.blurb: A wooden puppet pleads with the fearsome master of a marionette theater to spare his best friend from the fire.

spans.title: The Field of Wonders
spans.blurb: A wooden boy with five gold pieces meets a lame Fox and a blind Cat who know of a magic field where money grows overnight.

books.pairNote: Back to back episodes with no shared text; the longer one only glances back at the theater scene in passing.

spans.title: Behind the Curtain
spans.blurb: At a party, a bashful girl slips behind a curtain to hide and finds the boy from next door already there.

spans.title: Thin Ice
spans.blurb: Refused forgiveness at home, a younger sister chases the skaters down the frozen river, where the ice past the bend has gone soft.

books.pairNote: Separate scenes, one at a dance and one on the river, with no shared text or shared payoff.

spans.title: The Footprint in the Sand
spans.blurb: Walking to his boat, a castaway long alone finds something pressed into the sand that stops him cold.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the island's long solitude is broken, a shock the novel spends years of story building toward.

spans.title: Cast Ashore
spans.blurb: Eleven men abandon a dying ship in a small boat as mountainous seas drive them toward an unknown shore.

books.pairNote: The wreck and the footprint sit years apart in the tale and share nothing.

spans.title: Her Duty to Go
spans.blurb: A daughter dresses for the ball her father has forbidden. Her father is waiting downstairs by the front door.

spans.title: The Tread in the Darkness
spans.blurb: A stumble in an underground stream leaves an explorer without light in a cave labyrinth. Then he hears footsteps, and they are not human.
spans.spoilerNote: Confirms that something real and enormous lives in the cave, a question the full tale keeps in doubt for longer.

spans.title: The Face in the Water
spans.blurb: Adrift in a lifeboat, a young man leans over the side toward a beautiful face floating on the sea.

spans.title: The Tug That Charged
spans.blurb: A little tug swings its bow toward a surfaced enemy submarine and rings for full speed. Her crew means to board, with pistols, fists, and one good dog.
spans.brokenNote: The battle resolves fully, but the last sentence is clipped mid phrase and visibly trails off.

books.pairNote: Sequential beats of the same escape; the story assumes the rescue the short depicts but repeats none of it.

spans.title: The Banshee
spans.blurb: Five armed men look up from a strange land at something flapping across the sky, and not one of them remembers his rifle.

spans.title: Can't Waste Ammunition
spans.blurb: When a giant cave bear charges out of a thicket, one man trips in the roots, and the coolest head in the party makes himself the bait.

books.pairNote: Two separate encounters with different creatures; neither steals the other's payoff.

spans.title: The Milkman Trick
spans.blurb: With watchers on the street and a body in his rooms, a man stakes his whole escape on the morning milkman.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the murder of the hero's houseguest, the shock that sets the novel moving, though none of its later secrets.
